name: Photon
notes: Text in edit mode has a bounding box: drag its handles to scale point text or resize a paragraph box (the text rewraps; Ctrl+drag scales it), or drag just outside the box to move the text. 0.2.0 added Bevel & Emboss, Satin, patterns, Warp, Fade, Paste Into, Replace Color and the Patch, Background Eraser, Pattern Stamp and Color Sampler tools.
